name: ESO 219-010 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 219-010, a dwarf elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso21910-hubble
story: Once counted among the dwarf elliptical galaxies of the Centaurus A group, this faint galaxy barely breaks into individual stars in Hubble's view, a hint that it lies much farther away than once thought.

claims.text: ESO 219-010 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy studied as a member of the Centaurus A group
In Hubble's ACS images it is essentially unresolved into stars, suggesting a larger distance than the earlier estimate
